home.heroTitle: All your medical needs in one place
home.heroBody: Find verified doctors, hospitals, centers, pharmacies and laboratories, see their services and how to reach them.
home.searchBody: Pick a type and governorate, or search by name.
home.servicesBody: The platform grows phase by phase. What is available works end to end; what is next is clearly marked.

services.providers: Discover verified doctors and medical facilities by type, specialty and governorate.
services.jobs: Medical jobs and a specialised job market.
services.marketplace: A marketplace for medical equipment and supplies between companies and providers.
services.realEstate: Clinics and properties suited for medical use.

home.featuredBody: Real profiles verified by Racheeta administrators.
home.featuredEmptyBody: The first verified provider will appear here.

why.verifiedBody: No provider is public before Racheeta administrators review and verify the profile.
why.accountBody: One account for patients, providers and companies, with permissions decided by the server, never the app.
why.arabicBody: An interface designed for Arabic from day one, and ready for English.

home.ctaTitle: Are you a doctor or do you run a medical facility?
home.ctaBody: Create a provider account, complete your professional profile and request verification so patients can find you.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number (digits, optional country code).
validation.url: Enter a link starting with https://

passwordRules.title: Password rules

register.intro: Create your account in a minute. Your professional profile can follow later.
register.roleHint: The account type decides what you can do later. It cannot be changed by yourself after registration.

profile.verificationSent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
profile.noPassword: This account signs in through an external provider and has no password.
profile.contactBody: The fields you can edit yourself.
profile.capabilitiesBody: Informational codes only; the server decides permissions.

forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox.

reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
reset.success: Your password was changed. Log in with the new password.

verifyEmail.invalidLink: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from your account page.

notFound.body: The address you requested does not exist.

providers.intro: Find verified doctors, hospitals, centers, pharmacies and laboratories.
providers.empty: No providers match. Try changing the filters.

providerDetail.bookingSoon: Online appointment booking arrives in a later phase.

providerProfile.title: My provider profile
providerProfile.onboardingIntro: Your account is a provider account. Create your professional profile; it becomes public once verified.
providerProfile.verificationHint: Your profile appears publicly after Racheeta administrators verify it.
providerProfile.typeLocked: The provider type cannot change after verification.
providerProfile.noServices: You have not added services yet.

providerProfile.membershipsIntroFacility: Invite verified practitioners, or respond to their requests.
providerProfile.counterpartId: Counterpart id (from its public profile page)
providerProfile.notProvider: This page is only for provider accounts.
providerProfile.workspaceIntro: Your provider workspace: professional profile, services, memberships and verification status.
providerProfile.detailsIntro: What patients see on your public profile once verified.
providerProfile.servicesIntro: The services you offer and their prices. Inactive services are not public.
providerProfile.counterpartHint: Copy the id from the other party's public profile link (/providers/…).

footer.tagline: Racheeta brings verified medical providers in Iraq together in one place, Arabic-first.

auth.sideTitle: A trusted medical platform, one account.
auth.sideBody: Log in to reach your account, or create a new one as a patient or provider.
